description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface for converting between domain entities and data transfer objects related to external asset owner transfers in the Fineract project. It specifies mappings for transferring data between `ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer`, `ExternalTransferOwnerData`, and `ExternalTransferDataDetails` objects, and refers to related classes and external mappers.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersTransferMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting domain objects related to external asset owner transfers to and from their corresponding data transfer objects.

methods.name: mapTransfer
methods.description: Maps an ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer domain object to ExternalTransferData DTO, applying field-specific mappings.

methods.name: mapOwner
methods.description: Converts an ExternalAssetOwner domain object to ExternalTransferOwnerData DTO.

methods.name: mapDetails
methods.description: Converts an ExternalAssetOwnerTransferDetails domain object to ExternalTransferDataDetails DTO.
